authorisation: user brief 'ReST-GI - Worklog 47 Minimal Directional Nonlocal Transport Representation Smoke' (2026-10-27)
question: Under a minimal but valid nonlocal transport setting, does collapsing incoming boundary radiance to scalar irradiance remove information needed to predict directional boundary transport, and can a small direction-aware linear operator recover it under controlled supervision?

budget.note: Stage A / C are numpy closed form on CPU; GPU use planned 0 min

stage_a.units: port = strip of width 1 (area 1 per unit length); radiance per bin = bin-averaged radiance; Omega_perp_j = projected solid angle of bin j (sum = pi); E_p = sum_j L(p,j) Omega_perp_j
stage_a.direction_convention: incident direction w points from the port toward the source (z > 0); light travels along -w into the domain; outgoing direction points away from the port (z > 0)
stage_a.bins: j = ring * 4 + sector; sector s centred at azimuth s * 90 deg; centroid polar angle sin^2 = mean of the ring's sin^2 edges; 12 bins per port, 48 boundary states

S0.meaning: angular-insensitive nonlocal control: Lambertian entry (flux t_in * A * E_p), port-to-port redistribution g(q|p) = c exp(-|x_q - x_p| / ell), Lambertian exit

S1.meaning: angular-sensitive nonlocal positive control: fixed internal rough mirror at depth h; a beam entering port p in bin j exits at x_p - 2 h tan(theta_j) cos(phi_j) (box overlap with port strips), in the mirrored-azimuth bin (0.7) and its two azimuthal neighbours (0.1 each)

stage_a.pair_rule: for each port with E_A(p) > 0 draw a new 1-3 bin angular distribution with the same E; ports with E = 0 stay 0

criteria.S1_sensitive: mean over pairs of ||Y_A - Y_B|| / max(||Y_A||, ||Y_B||) >= 0.10 with per-port E match <= 1e-9 relative

field_sampler: per input port: active with probability 0.75; 1-3 distinct bins / directions with Dirichlet(1) shares of E ~ U(0.2, 1); radiance = share * E / Omega_perp (synthetic) or irradiance share (renderer)

stage_b_mir.meaning: renderer positive control: a closed black box (x [-0.55, 0.55], y [-0.2, 0.2], z [0, 0.2] m) whose floor is a rough mirror (Cycles Glossy GGX, colour 0.9, roughness 0.25); four ceiling windows (ports) of x-width 0.1 at centres -0.45, -0.15, 0.15, 0.45; the interior path window -> mirror -> window is internal to the fixed domain (enclosed, never exposed to another domain); it is a surrogate for an internal-reflection path, not SSS
stage_b_mir.direction_semantics: input t: sun light travels along normalize(t, 0, -1); its specular exit leaves along normalize(t, 0, 1) at x_in + 2 h t; output t: orthographic camera viewing along -normalize(t, 0, 1)
stage_b_mir.port_isolation: shadow-only masks (camera / diffuse / glossy / transmission invisible) 0.5 mm above every window that is not an input of the render
stage_b_mir.measurement: port value = mean of point-sampled (GAUSSIAN 0.01) pixel radiance whose camera ray hits the window plane inside the window inset by 5 mm; 64 x 64 px, ortho scale 1.3, luminance = mean RGB
stage_b_mir.irradiance_measurement: white Lambertian (rho 1) planes in the open windows, top orthographic camera, E = pi * mean L over the inset window

render.seeds: basis 4710 + b (replicate + 100); fields 4730 + i (replicate + 100); irradiance 4750 + i

stage_b_mir.pairs_note: [signed tan, E share]; suns illuminate every open window, so per-port E is matched by construction and measured; R2 also checks superposition against the basis renders

stage_b_sss.meaning: renderer relevance control for the regime that dominates the K44 error: the blend's own Lego 'Yellow' material (Burley SSS 0.98 + Glossy 0.02) on a 3 x 1 m plane; a shadow-only half-plane occluder edge along y at x = 0; both suns lie in the y-z plane, so the shadow edge does not move with polar angle
stage_b_sss.justification: worklogs 44-45 attribute most of the K44 error to Yellow Burley SSS; whether its nonlocal response depends on incident angle at equal irradiance decides whether incoming collapse is relevant there
stage_b_sss.material_change: displacement link removed (bump normals would make irradiance angle-dependent independently of SSS); SSS / glossy nodes unchanged
stage_b_sss.image: 64 x 8 px over x [-0.10, 0.30] m (6.25 mm / px), orthographic

stage_b_criteria.E_match: relative per-port (MIR) / lit-region (SSS) irradiance discrepancy <= 0.03; otherwise CONFOUNDED
stage_b_criteria.sensitive: D_rel = ||Y_A - Y_B|| / max(||Y_A||, ||Y_B||) >= 0.10 and D_rel > 3 noise_D + delta_E
stage_b_criteria.insensitive: D_rel <= 3 noise_D + delta_E and that bound <= 0.05 (per SSS band / channel); otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
stage_b_criteria.superposition: ||R2_direct - basis combination|| / ||R2_direct|| <= 3 x its replicate noise + 0.02

stage_c.model: dense linear map W: input representation -> full boundary output state; closed-form solve of sum_visible ||W z - y||^2 + lam * tr(W^T Lap W) + eps ||W||^2 (lam = 1e-6, eps = 1e-9, both x trace(Z Z^T) / dim z); Lap = graph Laplacian over output bins of the same port (synthetic: azimuthal and radial neighbours; renderer: chain over signed tan); with visible-only supervision the hidden outputs are the Laplacian-harmonic extension of the visible ones (no extra hyperparameter); no optimiser, so no optimisation failure is possible

conditions.A0: E per input port; visible outputs only
conditions.A1: E per input port; all outputs
conditions.B0: per-bin incident radiance (synthetic) / per-direction irradiance share (renderer); visible outputs only
conditions.B1: same input as B0; all outputs

visible.synthetic: rings 0-1, sectors 0-1 (4 of 12 bins per port, all ports)
visible.renderer: signed tan -0.75, 0, 0.375 (3 of 8 directions, all ports)

regimes: MIR (renderer basis T_r, seed set 1; replicate set 2 for the noise floor)
metrics: nonlocal rel L2 (input port != output port blocks)
bounds: E-only linear floor = best E-only linear map fitted on the test set itself
E-only pair floor (any function of E) = sqrt(sum ||dY||^2 / 2 / sum(||Y_A||^2 + ||Y_B||^2))

criteria.directional_benefit: B1 held-out rel L2 <= 0.5 x A1 and B1 pair discrimination >= 0.8
criteria.learned: B1 held-out rel L2 <= 0.05 (synthetic) or <= max(0.05, 2 x reference noise floor) (renderer)
criteria.supervision_benefit: X1 hidden rel L2 <= 0.5 x X0 hidden rel L2 for X in {A, B}
criteria.irradiance_sufficient: A1 held-out rel L2 <= 0.05 and E-only floor <= 0.05

stage_c.effects: A0->A1, A1->B1, B0->B1, A0->B0 as signed differences of held-out / hidden rel L2; interaction (B1 - B0) - (A1 - A0)

cases.1: renderer differs under matched E and B1 learns
cases.2: renderer differs, B1 does not learn
cases.5: only synthetic supports / renderer invalid or confounded

case_rule: classified per renderer regime (MIR, SSS); no claim beyond the tested regime
stop_rules: reference too noisy (bound > 0.05 where insensitivity would be claimed) -> INCONCLUSIVE
oracle linearity / passivity test failure -> stop
superposition failure -> renderer measurement invalid for Stage C

amendments.before: Stage C results (Stage A / B already run)
amendments.change: Stage C field sampler redraws all-zero configurations (nonzero=True); Stage A sampler unchanged
amendments.reason: the MIR regime (2 input ports, P(all inactive) = 1/16) produced an all-zero configuration in both the training and the test set, failing the predeclared train / test separation assertion; zero configurations carry no information. No Stage C metric had been written or printed.
